Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.config.core

Class ImagePathManager

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.config.core.ImagePathManager
@Component public class ImagePathManager extends Object
Centralized image path management system that handles all path resolution strategies. This class provides intelligent path resolution, JAR extraction, and SikuliX integration.
